latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-airportsapi skill.

- Provides access to the airportsapi API (version v1).
- Supports retrieving airport details with GET /airportsapi/v1/airports/{icao_code}.
- OAuth2 authentication required; set AIRPORTSAPI_API_KEY in environment.
- Includes usage instructions, CLI commands, and endpoint mapping guidance.
